entities.name: Query MinE protein
observations: 91 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt C4Z090 from Lachnospira eligens.
Contains Pfam MinE domain PF03776.21 spanning residues 1–83 with i-Evalue 1.1e-27.
Predicted molecular weight is 10,118.6 Da and theoretical pI is 5.03.
Likely functions as a cell-division topological specificity factor that spatially regulates MinC/MinD inhibition.

entities.name: MinC/MinD system
observations: Bacterial division-positioning system; MinE counteracts MinC/MinD inhibition at internal sites while allowing polar inhibition.

entities.name: Bacterial cell division positioning
observations: MinE-mediated spatial control of the MinC/MinD system promotes division-septum assembly at the cell midpoint.
